Rashi on Gittin 33b:10:1.english: An incident and Rabbi acted - In Ketubot, in the chapter [entitled] Almanah Nizonit:

Rashi on Gittin 33b:10:2.hebrew: כדברי חכמים - שהיו אומרים: שום הדיינים שפיחתו שתות או הותירו שתות, מכרן בטל:
Rashi on Gittin 33b:10:2.english: In accordance with the statement of the Sages - who used to say: An appraisal by the judges in which they undervalued [the property] by a sixth or overvalued [it] by a sixth — their sale is void:

Rashi on Gittin 33b:10:3.hebrew: והחזיר רבי את המעשה - אלמא הדר ביה וקם בשיטתיה דרבן שמעון [ב"ג] ליפות כח בית דין, אלמא בהא הלכה כרבן שמעון [ב"ג]:
Rashi on Gittin 33b:10:3.english: And Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi] reversed the action - Thus he retracted and adopted the position of Rabban Shimon [ben Gamliel] to enhance the authority of the court; thus in this [matter], the halakha is in accordance with Rabban Shimon [ben Gamliel]:

Rashi on Gittin 33b:12:1.hebrew: ואשקליה גיטא על כרחיה - השיאו בעל כרחיה לגרש את אשתו, כגון בהנך דאמרינן בהו: "יוציא ויתן כתובה":
Rashi on Gittin 33b:12:1.english: And he extracted a bill of divorce from him against his will - He compelled him against his will to divorce his wife, such as in those [cases] regarding which we say: "He must divorce [her] and pay [her] ketubah":

Rashi on Gittin 33b:12:2.english: And he said to them - Rabbi Yoshiya [said this] to the witnesses:

Rashi on Gittin 33b:12:3.hebrew: זילו איטמורו - לאחר שכפאוהו עד שיאמר "רוצה אני", הסתירו עצמכם כדי שלא יבטל אתכם מן העדות:
Rashi on Gittin 33b:12:3.english: Go hide - After they have coerced him until he says, "I want [to]," hide yourselves so that he will not nullify you from [giving] the testimony:

Rashi on Gittin 33b:13:1.hebrew: ואי ס"ד - בקמייתא הלכתא כרבי — שאם ביטלו בפני שנים אחרים, מבוטל — כי מיטמרי הני, מאי הוי:
Rashi on Gittin 33b:13:1.english: And if it enters your mind - [that] in the first [dispute] the halakha is in accordance with Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi] — that if he annulled it before two others, it is annulled — when these [elders] hide, what of it?

Rashi on Gittin 33b:14:1.hebrew: ליבדרו איבדורי - שלא ימצאם ביחד, ואינו יכול לבטל זה שלא בפני זה:
Rashi on Gittin 33b:14:1.english: Let them scatter - so that [the husband] will not find them together, and he cannot annul [one] not in the presence of [another]:

Rashi on Gittin 33b:1:1.hebrew: לא בטלה כולה - הלכך לא חש רבן גמליאל להושיב ב"ד ולימנות על כך, שאין בזו מפני תיקון העולם, דאי אזלי הנך דלא בטיל קמייהו, וכתבי ויהבי לה, ואזלא ומינסבא, שפיר קא מינסבא:
Rashi on Gittin 33b:1:1.english: It is not entirely invalidated - Therefore, Rabban Gamliel did not trouble himself to convene a court and take a vote on this, for there is no [concern] in this [case] on account of the betterment of the world [tikkun ha'olam]; for if those before whom he did not nullify [the agency] go and write and give [the bill of divorce] to her, and she goes and marries, she marries validly:

Rashi on Gittin 33b:1:2.hebrew: בטלה כולה - ואפי' נשתיירו שנים שעדותן עדות, וזה לא בטל בפניהם, בטלו אף הן:
Rashi on Gittin 33b:1:2.english: [It is] entirely nullified - And even if two [agents] remained whose testimony is [valid] testimony, and this [husband] did not nullify [the agency] in their presence, they too are nullified:

Rashi on Gittin 33b:2:1.hebrew: והנך לא ידעי - דבטל, ואזלי וכתבי ויהבי לה, ומינסבא בגט פסול:
Rashi on Gittin 33b:2:1.english: And those do not know - that [their agency] was nullified, and they go and write [the bill of divorce] and give [it] to her, and she gets married with an invalid bill of divorce:

Rashi on Gittin 33b:3:1.hebrew: ואי בעית אימא לא בטלה כולה - ואין כאן גזירה, אלא טעמא דרשב"ג לא משום תקנה הוא, אלא קסבר אין ביטולו ביטול עד שיבטל בפני כולן; והאי "אינו יכול" דקאמר, לאו איסורא הוא משום עובר על תקנה, אלא הכי קאמר: אין בו כח לבטל אלא בפני כולן:
Rashi on Gittin 33b:3:1.english: And if you wish, say [that] it is not entirely invalidated - And there is no [rabbinic] decree here — rather, Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel's reason is not because of an enactment, but he holds [that] his nullification is not a [valid] nullification unless he nullifies [the agency] in the presence of all of them. And this "he cannot" that he states [in the Mishnah] is not a prohibition on account of transgressing an enactment; rather, this is what he is saying: he has no power to nullify [it] except in the presence of all of them:

Rashi on Gittin 33b:3:2.english: To revoke it - [literally,] to draw it out and to remove it:

Rashi on Gittin 33b:4:1.hebrew: כולכם - חתומו, דקי"ל דאינו גט עד שיחתמו כולן:
Rashi on Gittin 33b:4:1.english: All of you - [meaning, "All of you] sign," for we hold that it is not a [valid] bill of divorce until all of them sign:

Rashi on Gittin 33b:4:2.hebrew: מהו - מי אסר רבן שמעון [ב"ג] שלא יבטל את אחד או את שנים שלא בפני חבריהם:
Rashi on Gittin 33b:4:2.english: What is [the halakha] - Did Rabban Shimon [ben Gamliel] forbid [the husband] from nullifying [the agency of] one or two [of them] outside the presence of their fellows?

Rashi on Gittin 33b:4:3.hebrew: טעמא דרשב"ג - היכא דלא אמר "כולכם":
Rashi on Gittin 33b:4:3.english: The reason of Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel - [that is, in the case] where he did not say "all of you":

Rashi on Gittin 33b:4:4.hebrew: משום דקסבר בטלה כולה - וחייש דלמא אזלי הני דלא ידעי בביטולא ויהבי לה, והכא ליכא למיחש להכי, דמידע ידעי דכולן צריכין לחתום, וכל כמה דלא חתימו כולהו, לא יהבי לה:
Rashi on Gittin 33b:4:4.english: Because he holds [that] it is entirely invalidated - and he is concerned lest these [agents] who do not know of the nullification go and give [it] to her; but here there is no [reason] to be concerned about this, for they certainly know that all of them must sign, and as long as all of them have not signed, they will not give [it] to her:

Rashi on Gittin 33b:5:1.hebrew: או דלמא משום דקסבר כו' - והלכך, לאו בטל הוא לגמרי, וחתמי ביה אפי' הני דבטיל קמייהו עם חבריהם, ויהבי לה:
Rashi on Gittin 33b:5:1.english: Or perhaps [it is] because he holds, etc. - And therefore, it is not completely nullified, and even those before whom he nullified [it] sign on it with their colleagues and give [it] to her:

Rashi on Gittin 33b:6:1.hebrew: יכול לבטל - והוי ביטול, ואין זה כשר להיות עוד עד בדבר עד שיצוהו:
Rashi on Gittin 33b:6:1.english: He can nullify [it] - and it is [a valid] nullification, and this one is no longer fit to be a witness in the matter until he commands him [again]:

Rashi on Gittin 33b:6:2.english: He cannot nullify - And that [agent] himself is [still] valid to sign [the bill of divorce]:

Rashi on Gittin 33b:6:3.hebrew: והא שנים - דכולם צריכין לחתום, וליכא למיחש דלמא אזיל חד וחתים בלא חבריה, וקאמר "אינו יכול לבטל", אלמא רבן שמעון לאו איסורא קאמר, אלא אינו ביטול קאמר:
Rashi on Gittin 33b:6:3.english: But two [agents] - [is a case] where all of them must sign, and there is no [need] to be concerned that perhaps one will go and sign without his fellow, and yet [Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel] says, "He cannot nullify [it]"; thus, Rabban Shimon is not stating a prohibition, rather he is stating [that] it is not a [valid] nullification:

Rashi on Gittin 33b:7:1.english: Rav Ashi said: If - these two are witnesses of [the] writing and signing [of the bill of divorce]:

Rashi on Gittin 33b:7:2.hebrew: הכי נמי - דמודה רבן שמעון [ב"ג] דיכול לבטל וביטולו ביטול, דטעמא משום גזירה היא, והכא ליכא למיגזר מידי:
Rashi on Gittin 33b:7:2.english: Indeed so - that Rabban Shimon [ben Gamliel] agrees that he can nullify [it] and his nullification is [valid], for the reason [for his ruling] is because of a decree, and here there is nothing to decree:

Rashi on Gittin 33b:7:3.hebrew: בעדי הולכה - דהאי "תנו" דקאמר הכא, לשנים הגט ניתן להם להיות שלוחים ולמוסרו לה, דהכא כי קאמר לחד, אזיל אידך דלא ידע ומסר לה, לפי שאין זה עדות שיהו שניהם צריכין להיות שם, אלא שליחות; ולא ידע דבטלה שליחותא, דשליחות שבטלה מקצתה בטלה כולה, דכי היכי דבטליה להאי, בטליה להאי:
Rashi on Gittin 33b:7:3.english: With witnesses of delivery - For this [word] "give" that [the baraita] states here [means that] the bill of divorce is given to two [people] to be agents and to deliver it to her; for here, when he says [that he nullifies it] to one [of them], the other [agent], who does not know, goes and delivers it to her, because this is not [a matter of] testimony where both of them must be present, but rather agency; and he does not know that the agency has been nullified, for an agency that is partially nullified is entirely nullified, since just as he nullified it for this one, he nullified it for that one:

Rashi on Gittin 33b:8:1.hebrew: ה"נ מסתברא - דבעדי הולכה קאמר, וטעמא משום חששא דלמא אזל האי דלא ידע ויהיב לה:
Rashi on Gittin 33b:8:1.english: This too stands to reason - that [the baraita] is speaking of witnesses of delivery, and the reason is because of the concern lest this one, who does not know [of the nullification], go and give [the bill of divorce] to her:

Rashi on Gittin 33b:8:2.hebrew: אמר לזה בפני עצמו כו' - אי מתחלה, כשעשאן שלוחים, לא אמר לשניהם יחד, אלא לאחד מהן, וחזר ואמר לחבירו: "הנה מסרתי גט לפלוני לתתו לאשתי, ואם תרצה, גם אתה הוי שליח לגרשה":
Rashi on Gittin 33b:8:2.english: [If] one said to this [one] on his own, etc. - If originally, when he appointed them as agents, he did not speak to both of them together, but rather to one of them, and then he went and said to his fellow: "Behold, I have handed a bill of divorce to So-and-so to give it to my wife, and if you wish, you too be an agent to divorce her":

Rashi on Gittin 33b:8:3.hebrew: יכול לבטל - ובטל זה מתורת השליחות, שאם גרשה זה אינה מגורשת; אבל השני יכול לגרש, דכיון דמתחלה לא בבת אחת הוי, אין כאן לומר "שליחות שבטלה מקצתה בטלה כולה", ואי אזיל האי דלא ידע בביטולא ויהיב לה, שפיר קיהיב לה:
Rashi on Gittin 33b:8:3.english: He can nullify - And this one [whose agency he nullified] is nullified from the status of agency, so that if this one divorces her, she is not divorced. However, the second one can divorce [her], for since from the outset [their appointment] was not [done] simultaneously, there is no [basis] here to say, "an agency that was partially nullified is completely nullified"; and if that [other] one who does not know of the nullification goes and gives [the bill of divorce] to her, he gives [it] to her validly:

Rashi on Gittin 33b:8:4.hebrew: שפיר - איכא למימר "אמר לזה בפני עצמו", שאין זה עדות שיצטרכו לראות או לשמוע העדות תחילה כאחד:
Rashi on Gittin 33b:8:4.english: Well - It is possible to say "he said to this one on his own," for this is not [a matter of] testimony where they need to see or hear the testimony together at the outset.

Rashi on Gittin 33b:8:5.hebrew: אלא אי אמרת עדי חתימה - הא עדות גמורה בעינן, ומי מצטרפי כי אמר לזה בפני עצמו ולזה בפני עצמו:
Rashi on Gittin 33b:8:5.english: However, if you say [they are] witnesses of signing - surely we require full testimony, and can they combine [together] when he spoke to this one on his own and to that one on his own?

Rashi on Gittin 33b:8:6.english: Until the two of them see [it] as one - the testimony:

Rashi on Gittin 33b:8:7.hebrew: כר' יהושע בן קרחה - דפליג עלה בפרק שני דכתובות (דף כו:) ובסנהדרין (דף ל:), ואמר: אפי' בזה אחר זה:
Rashi on Gittin 33b:8:7.english: In accordance with Rabbi Yehoshua ben Korḥa - who disagrees with it [that ruling] in the second chapter of Ketubot (26b) and in Sanhedrin (30b), and says: [Their testimony combines] even [when they saw the event] one after the other:

Rashi on Gittin 33b:9:1.hebrew: שמעית מיניה דר' אבא תרתי - כלומר: בהנך תרתי פלוגתא דרבי ורשב"ג, בביטלו מבוטל וביכול לבטל זה שלא בפני זה, שמעית מיניה דרבי אבא דקבע הלכתא בתרווייהו — חדא כרבי וחדא כרבן שמעון [ב"ג]:
Rashi on Gittin 33b:9:1.english: I heard from Rabbi Abba two [things] - That is to say: regarding those two disputes of Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi] and Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel — concerning [whether, if] he cancelled it, it is cancelled, and concerning [whether] he can cancel [it] not in his presence — I heard from Rabbi Abba that he established the halakha in both of them, one in accordance with Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi] and one in accordance with Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel:

Tosafot on Gittin 33b:10:1.hebrew: אמר רב יוסף ניחזי אנן - אע"ג דרב יוסף אית ליה הכא דביטלו אינו מבוטל, קאמר רב יוסף בפ"ק דקידושין (דף יב:) דרב מנגיד אמאן דמבטל גיטא, אע"ג דאינו מבוטל, דמ"מ הרי מוציא לעז על הגט, כי היכי דמנגיד אמאן דמקדש בשוקא או בביאה, אע"ג דליכא איסורא:
Tosafot on Gittin 33b:10:1.english: Rav Yosef said: Let us see - Even though Rav Yosef holds here that if he voided it, it is not voided, Rav Yosef says in the first chapter of Kiddushin (12b) that Rav administers lashes to one who voids a bill of divorce, even though it is not voided, because in any event he is casting aspersions on the bill of divorce, just as he administers lashes to one who betroths [a woman] in the marketplace or through intercourse, even though there is no prohibition:

Tosafot on Gittin 33b:10:2.hebrew: וחזר רבי ועשה כרשב"ג - וא"ת: מנא ליה משום דחזר בו התם, דחזר בו נמי ממאי דאמר ביטלו מבוטל? דלמא ההיא דשום הדיינים דמי טפי לביטלו שלא בב"ד, דהתם מודה רבי דאינו מבוטל, דאמרי' "מה כח ב"ד יפה", כדפרישית לעיל? וי"ל, דרב יוסף מדמה להו, משום דלא איפלגו רבי ורשב"ג אלא בהני תרי מילי, במה כח ב"ד יפה: בשום הדיינין, ובביטול הגט בב"ד; ולכך מדמה להו אהדדי, ומסתמא כשחזר מזה חזר נמי מזה:
Tosafot on Gittin 33b:10:2.english: And Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi] reversed [his ruling] and acted in accordance with Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel - And if you ask: From where does [Rav Yosef] know that because [Rabbi] retracted there, he also retracted from what he said [here, that if] he nullified it, it is nullified? Perhaps that [case] of the judges' appraisal is more similar to [a case where] he nullified it not in a court, where there Rabbi agrees that it is not nullified, because we say "what advantage does the court have?" as I explained above? And one can answer: Rav Yosef compares them because Rabbi and Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel only disagreed regarding these two matters with respect to "what advantage does the court have?" — [namely,] in the judges' appraisal and in the nullification of a bill of divorce in a court — and therefore he compares them to one another, and presumably when he retracted from this one, he also retracted from that one:

Tosafot on Gittin 33b:14:1.hebrew: ליבדרו איבדורי - אפי' למאן דמוקי פלוגתייהו בעדות שבטלה מקצתה, דייק שפיר דבהא קי"ל כרבי; דלדידיה ליכא למימר דלבדורי איבדור, דכיון שיכול לבטל זה שלא בפני זה, לא יועיל פיזור, דיבטל כל אחד שימצא בפני עצמו עד שיבטל כולן. אבל לרשב"ג, דאין יכול לבטל זה שלא בפני זה, אין בביטולו כלום אפי' מבטל כולם כל אחד בפני עצמו; אע"ג דהשתא ליכא למיחש דלמא אזלי הנך דלא ידעי וכתבי ויהבי לה, לא הוי ביטול עד שיבטל כולם יחד זה בפני זה:
Tosafot on Gittin 33b:14:1.english: Let them scatter - Even according to the one who establishes their dispute as regarding testimony that was partially nullified, [the Gemara] infers well that in this [dispute] we hold in accordance with Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi]; for according to him, one cannot say that they should scatter, since he can nullify [one] not in the presence of [another], scattering would not help, as he will nullify each one whom he finds by himself until he nullifies all of them. However, according to Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel, [who holds] that he cannot nullify [one] not in the presence of [another], his nullification is nothing even if he nullifies all of them, each one by himself; even though now there is no concern that perhaps those who do not know will go and write and give [it] to her, it is not a [valid] nullification until he nullifies all of them together, one in the presence of another:

Tosafot on Gittin 33b:3:1.hebrew: צריכי בי עשרה למשלפה - ואפי' אותם שנים שביטל יכולין לכתוב. ותימה: כיון דמדאורייתא יכול לבטל אפי' שלא בפניהם, אמאי תקנו חכמים שלא יועיל ביטול לגבי אותם שנים עצמם? וי"ל: כיון שהוצרכו לתקן שאין ביטול מועיל לגבי אחרים, תיקנו נמי שלא יהא לו כח לבטל בזה הגט כלל:
Tosafot on Gittin 33b:3:1.english: Ten are required to revoke it - And even those two [agents] whom he nullified can write [it]. And it is difficult: since by Torah law he can nullify [it] even not in their presence, why did the Sages enact that nullification should not be effective with respect to those two themselves? And one can answer: since they needed to enact that nullification is not effective with respect to the others, they also enacted that he should not have the power to nullify this bill of divorce at all:
